summary: Nano Labs Ltd filed a Form 6-K announcing the resignation of Director Nan Hu, effective August 31, 2026. The board expressed appreciation for his service, and the company stated the resignation will not affect operations or strategic plans. This is a routine board departure without controversy, but it is the sole event of the filing. No terms, advisors, or premiums are provided. The company remains focused on governance and long-term value. What to watch: any subsequent board appointments or strategic shifts, though the resignation appears orderly and non-disruptive.
